fields.label: Do you or any of your branches/offices, subsidiaries or joint ventures have current or contemplated activity, directly or indirectly, in, with or involving any Sanctioned Jurisdiction?
fields.description: Whether the client has any activity in a sanctioned jurisdiction

fields.label: Are you or any of your branches/offices, subsidiaries or joint ventures currently engaged or contemplate engaging in activities in any of the sectors in Russia that are subject to Sanctions, including without limitation: technology, defense and related materiel, electronics, marine, energy, accounting, trust and corporate formation, management consulting, quantum computing, trading/commodities brokering, financing and financial services, shipping, insurance, architecture, engineering, manufacturing, transportation, metals and mining, quarrying, fish/seafood (and preparations thereof), alcoholic beverages or non-industrial diamonds and diamond jewelry?
fields.description: Whether the client is involved in sanctioned Russian sectors
fields.instructions: Select Yes if engaged, otherwise No

fields.label: Do you or any of your branches/offices, subsidiaries or joint ventures rely on an authorization or license from a sanctions/regulatory authority to conduct any activity with or involving a Sanctioned Party, Sanctioned Jurisdiction or involving goods or services in scope of export controls?
fields.description: Indicates whether the client relies on an authorization or licence to deal with sanctioned parties, jurisdictions or export‑controlled goods/services.
fields.instructions: If Yes is selected, please provide further details below.

fields.label: Do you or any of your branches/offices, subsidiaries or joint ventures have current or contemplated activity, directly or indirectly, in, with or involving the government of Afghanistan, Lebanon, Myanmar, Venezuela or Zimbabwe or any entity which is more than 50% owned or controlled by such government (collectively "Government")?
fields.description: Asks whether the client or its entities are involved with the listed governments or entities controlled by them.
fields.instructions: If Yes is selected, please provide further details on the activity.

fields.label: Do you intend to use or make available to your branches/offices, subsidiaries, joint ventures or any other third person, any La Banque des Entreprises accounts, products (including any partial usage of loans), services, systems, or platforms, directly or indirectly, to conduct any activity with or involving a Sanctioned Party, a Sanctioned Jurisdiction or the Government of any country listed in Question 4 (including any activities that are specifically authorized or not prohibited)?
fields.description: Determines whether the client plans to use the bank’s products or platforms for activities involving sanctioned parties, jurisdictions or listed governments.
fields.instructions: If Yes is selected, specify the account/product/service and how it will be used; if No, describe the controls in place.

fields.label: Do you or any of your branches/offices or subsidiaries have a director, senior officer, shareholder, or are you or your branches/offices, subsidiaries or joint ventures controlled by a person or entity who is either: a) a Sanctioned Party; b) located, organized, registered in, or operating from a Sanctioned Jurisdiction; c) employed in a Sanctioned Jurisdiction; d) representing a governmental agency or authority of a Sanctioned Jurisdiction or any country listed in Question 4?
fields.description: Checks whether any controlling persons or entities are sanctioned or linked to sanctioned jurisdictions.
fields.instructions: If Yes is selected, provide names of involved entities and percentage of ownership.
